decision: Exact-width integer shifts with counts modulo the left width; arithmetic signed right shift; no numeric promotions or enum shifts

sources.status: Official current C# reference, implemented behavior
sources.applicability: Masked counts and arithmetic signed right shift are applicable. C# promotions, bool bitwise operators and unsigned-right-shift glyph are not adopted.
Invalid counts are treated as overflow; profile-dependent checking is not chosen for VOID. VOID preserves identical wrapping bit-pattern behavior across profiles.

Counts at least as wide as operands produce poison. VOID masks in the count type before conversion, then emits plain shl/ashr/lshr without nsw/nuw/exact. Pinned LLVM23 APIs are verified by builds and execution.

scope: Bounded design research, not upstream bug/backport adoption.
